windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -PathType Leaf)) { if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 -m venv .venv } else { python -m venv .venv }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; if ((-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.venv\Scripts\ruff.exe' -PathType Leaf)) -or (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.venv\Scripts\anyinfer.exe' -PathType Leaf))) { & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe workspace.py setup; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

linux.command: if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv || exit; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/ruff ] || [ ! -x .venv/bin/anyinfer ]; then .venv/bin/python workspace.py setup; fi

osx.command: if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv || exit; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/ruff ] || [ ! -x .venv/bin/anyinfer ]; then .venv/bin/python workspace.py setup; fi
